description: Evaluator-private deterministic commands for rebuilding the runtime target in gt-memory-env. These commands build artifacts only; PoC execution is described by runtime_spec.json.

commands.command: if grep -q JS_SetModuleLoaderFunc2 quickjs.h; then python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('fuzz/fuzz_common.c'); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace('JS_SetModuleLoaderFunc(rt, NULL, js_module_loader, NULL);','JS_SetModuleLoaderFunc2(rt, NULL, js_module_loader, js_module_check_attributes, NULL);'); p.write_text(s)"; fi

CONFIG_CLANG=y CC=clang CXX=clang++ CFLAGS="-O1 -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer" CXXFLAGS="-O1 -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer" make -j2 libquickjs.fuzz.a .obj/fuzz_common.o .obj/libregexp.fuzz.o .obj/cutils.fuzz.o .obj/libunicode.fuzz.o >/tmp/quickjs_build.log
